intro: Explore Marbella on the Costa del Sol: the flower-filled Old Town, Orange Square, beaches, the Golden Mile and nearby Puerto Banús. Plan days out and save your favourite places, memorable visits and personal photos on your device.

areas.name: Marbella Old Town
areas.description: Explore whitewashed streets, shops and cafés around Plaza de los Naranjos.

areas.name: Marbella seafront
areas.description: Walk the Paseo Marítimo between beaches and beachside cafés.

areas.name: Golden Mile
areas.description: Coastal stretch between central Marbella and Puerto Banús with hotels and beach clubs.

areas.name: Puerto Banús
areas.description: Marina with yachts, shops, waterfront restaurants and evening walks.

areas.name: San Pedro Alcántara
areas.description: Town west of Marbella with a pedestrian boulevard and beachfront promenade.

areas.name: Nueva Andalucía
areas.description: Residential and golf area inland from Puerto Banús.

areas.name: Cabopino
areas.description: Marina and beaches east of Marbella, near the Artola dunes.

attractions.description: Wander the narrow streets, small shops and traditional Andalusian architecture.

attractions.name: Avenida del Mar

attractions.name: Dunas de Artola

attractions.name: Parque de la Alameda
attractions.description: Shaded central park close to Avenida del Mar.

transport.name: Driving
